messages:
kevin_h: Hi folks! Kevin here, first day on Product Analytics. Quick housekeeping: laptop boots but MDM enrollment stuck at "Waiting for company profile". Badge hasn't been activated yet so can't access office snacks. Any pointers? Also two fun facts: I used to work as a weekend barista and I have a rubber duck named 'Euler' who reviews my SQL. :coffee: :duck: 

natalie_ops: welcome Kevin!! :tada: For the MDM thing jump to the device enrollment guide and try the "Re-enroll" flow under Troubleshooting. If it still blocks, DM infra with your device serial. Badge: file a desk access request here: https://redwood.hr/access-requests 

jules: hey @kevin_h i can ping facilities to speed up the badge activation. what desk number are you at? i'll CC them. 

kevin_h: thanks @jules, desk 4B. sending serial to infra in a sec. 

infra-bot: Automated: Onboarding tasks created for kevin_h. Tasks: create GH account, add to slack groups, MDM enroll, badge activation. See https://redwood.onboard/tasks/2367123456 

marc_s: pro tip: if MDM UI hangs, try removing the profile then run `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` (mac). worked for me last week. 

kevin_h: tried remove+renew and it progressed! thanks @marc_s. badge still pending though. 

jules: facilities confirmed; badge queued for activation, ETA ~30m. Welcome to the snack cupboard. :popcorn: 

natalie_ops: also heads up - Product Analytics has a weekly brown-bag on Wednesdays. we pair new folks with a mentor for the first month. i'll DM you your mentor. 

hr-bot: Reminder: please complete the benefits form and W-4 by EOD Friday to avoid payroll delays. https://redwood.hr/forms 

kevin_h: perfect, done with MDM and added to slack groups. fun-fact follow-up: my barista specialty is lavender latte, happy to bring samples for the team. coffee vs tea poll? :coffee: :tea: 

jules: coffee please! lavender lattes sound amazing. 

marc_s: tea for me but i'll take a sample. welcome aboard. 

kevin_h: thanks everyone 44b see you all at the intro stand-up later.
